why: Makes a real request to MusicBrainz, so pull requests don't depend on it; the live-musicbrainz workflow sets PYSACD_LIVE_MB=1 and runs it.

Replays the inputs that once crashed the fuzz harness from fuzz/regressions, which holds none yet (only .gitkeep), so pytest has no parameters and skips. Nothing is untested; when the first regression file is added this stops skipping and CI says to remove the entry.
Needs a container image of sacdfs main, which only the 'tags served by sacdfs main' job builds, where it runs (and must not skip).
